## Session Brief

* [V1: the 2D (pt(γ), m(μμ)) cell and an honest-error estimate](V1.md) - Run the named 2D probe cell on both sides and an adaptation-free estimate of the radiative-return windows, to separate this side's η(γ) at fixed m(μμ) from MadGraph's under-recovery.

## Session Report

* [V1 report: the ee → μμγ offset is MadEvent's, in its Z radiative-return channels](V1-report.md) - An adaptation-free estimator agrees with vibegraph in every window and cell. The bank reads 1.00 % low. MadEvent's Z-ISR channels (G6, G8) have rare, very large weights; its mean²/σ² iteration combination discounts them, and more budget does not shrink the bias. Recombining MadEvent's own iterations with equal weights at 100k events closes it.
